card.name: Words just before ophthalmology terms
card.fires_on: Small words like 'an', 'and', 'frequent' or 'indirect' that come right before an expected eye-exam word such as ophthalmologist, ophthalmological or ophthalmoscopy. It fires in eye-related label text.

modes.label: Article before ophthalmologist
modes.description: The word 'an' in the phrase advising referral to an eye specialist.
modes.example: Consider referral to<< an>> ophthalmologist in patients who develop oc

modes.label: Modifier before ophthalmoscopy
modes.description: Words like 'indirect' or 'frequent' that lead into ophthalmoscopy or ophthalmological examinations.
modes.example: Patients with CMV retinitis should have<< frequent>> ophthalmological examinations during treatment with g

modes.label: Linking word before slit lamp exams
modes.description: 'and' joining eye-exam procedures in a list of measurements.
modes.example: intraocular pressure measurements<< and>> slit lamp examinations in a controlled 1

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with a word starting 'op' (as in ophthalmo-), and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before the text says ophthalmologist or ophthalmoscopy.
